title: vde configuration
description: The vde.yaml file of vde 1.x. vde config check is authoritative; this schema catches typos, types and enum values in an editor. Reference: docs/operator/configuration.md.

tls.description: TLS terminated in the binary; set both files or neither.

trusted_proxy.description: A reverse proxy terminates TLS; requests must carry X-Forwarded-Proto: https.

insecure_http.description: Accept plain HTTP from any peer, for development or a trusted private network only.

data_dir.description: Directory for the database, blobs and caches; default /var/lib/vde.

groups.description: Ordered failover lists of endpoint-model pairs by name.

extractor.description: The extractor role; its groups must have no classifier endpoint.

judge.description: The judge role; may use the extractor's group.

policy.description: When the judge is asked: always (default), never or auto.

feedback_fallback.description: Deprecated (removal in 2.0); still works, warns. What a classifier reject carries: whole_result (default) or llm feedback from feedback_group.

feedback_group.description: Deprecated with feedback_fallback (removal in 2.0). LLM group asked for feedback on classifier rejections; only with feedback_fallback: llm.

second_judge.description: Deprecated (removal in 2.0); still works, warns. An optional second judge that must also accept.

group.description: Group serving the second judge; empty means off.

limits.description: Bounds of the extraction loop and the documents accepted.

max_attempts.description: Default attempt limit per application; default 3.

job_timeout.description: Deadline per job from its creation; default 5m, at most 8m.

judge_reparse_tries.description: Extra judge calls when its verdict cannot be parsed; default 1.

feedback_message_chars.description: Characters kept per feedback message; 0 means 4000.

document_bytes.description: Largest document in bytes; default 25 MiB.

page_bytes.description: Largest page image in bytes; default 10 MiB.

pages.description: Most page images per job; default 20, at most 999.

request_bytes.description: Largest whole request body in bytes; default 128 MiB.

max_queued_jobs.description: Global ceiling on queued jobs, above which submissions answer 503; 0 means none.

max_submits_in_flight.description: Submissions one process reads and prepares at a time, above which submissions answer 503; default 16.

images.description: Image preparation at submit: downscale, EXIF rotation, WebP conversion.

enabled.description: Prepare images once at submit; default true.

convert_to.description: Type a converted image is encoded as; default image/jpeg.

pdf.description: How a PDF reaches groups that do not read application/pdf natively.

max_pages.description: Longer PDFs are refused unless read natively; default 20.

min_text_chars_per_page.description: Characters every page needs for auto to send text; default 200.

fetch.description: Deprecated, no effect (removal in 2.0): document URLs were removed in 1.1; setting a key warns.

enabled.description: Deprecated, no effect (removal in 2.0); allowed_hosts required when true.

timeout.description: Deprecated, no effect (removal in 2.0); at most 1m.

log_content.description: Deprecated, no effect (removal in 2.0); refused with a non-loopback listen.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the bearer token /metrics requires.

listen.description: A second listener, host:port, serving only /metrics.

go_runtime.description: Add the Go runtime and process series.

listen.description: Admin listener, host:port; default 127.0.0.1:8091, empty disables it.

poll_interval.description: Sleep of an idle worker between looks at the queue; default 500ms.

lease.description: Lease on a running job without renewal; default 2m.

shared.description: Count rate limits in the job store across replicas; default false.

log.description: Also write each audit event as a log line.

retention.description: How long audit events are kept; default 8760h.

dsn_env.description: Environment variable holding the PostgreSQL DSN; VDE_DATABASE_URL by default.

blobs.description: The blob store of documents and page images.

bucket.description: S3 bucket name; required with s3.

endpoint.description: S3 API URL of a non-AWS store; empty means AWS S3.

region.description: The bucket's region; required with s3.

path_style.description: Address the bucket in the URL path (MinIO).

sse.description: Server-side encryption: AES256 (default) or empty for none.

max_wait.description: Longest wait before answering 202; default 60s, at most 120s.

duration.description: A Go duration such as 90s, 3m or 1h30m; a bare number is rejected.

envName.description: Name of an environment variable; empty means none.

escalation.description: Deprecated (removal in 2.0); still works, warns. Serve the role from group from attempt from_attempt on.

from_attempt.description: First attempt served by group; strictly increasing.

group.description: Group serving the role from that attempt.

endpoint.description: One provider endpoint and the models it serves.

provider.description: Provider adapter; classifier is deprecated (removal in 2.0), still works and warns.

base_url.description: API base URL; default per provider or preset.

region.description: Cloud region; bedrock and vertex only.

project.description: Google Cloud project id; vertex only.

models.description: Models by name with their capability declaration.

accepts.description: Media types the model reads natively.

questions.description: The fixed questions of a classifier model; deprecated with provider classifier (removal in 2.0).

text.description: The question, phrased so that yes passes.

threshold.description: Probability of yes needed to pass.

group.description: An ordered failover list of endpoint-model pairs.

failover.description: Bounds of one role call across the pairs.

max_total_time.description: Time for one role call; default 3m, below limits.job_timeout.

failover_on_permanent.description: Try the next pair after a permanent failure.

application.description: One caller with its own limits.

window.description: ISO 8601 duration in weeks, days, hours, minutes or seconds; default P1D (also when empty).

max_in_progress.description: Jobs queued or running at once; 0 means 20.

default.description: Retention of retention: default jobs, a positive duration or none; default 24h (also when empty).

force_none.description: Treat every job as retention: none.

delete_blobs_at_terminal.description: Delete the document and pages at the terminal state instead of at expiry.

webhook.description: Completion webhook; empty url means none.

url.description: https URL receiving the signed job.finished notice.

secret_env.description: Environment variable holding the signing secret; required with url.

events.description: Events to send; job.finished is the only one.

policy.description: Overrides roles.judge.policy: always, never or auto.

allow_override.description: Let a request choose the policy with the judge part.

sample_rate.description: Under auto, the share of grounded jobs still sent to the judge; default 0.05.
